title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
abstract: arXiv:2611.30836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. translated_title: 多模态融合能否让具身视觉在退化感知中“说得通”（MakeSense）？
translated_abstract: 具身视觉系统依赖互补的传感器来感知环境并随条件变化而行动。即使是接受任意传感器子集的模型，也可能表现出“负融合”现象：增加一个传感器反而会增大预测误差。我们提出了MakeSense，一种多模态融合框架，它在私有流中保留传感器各自的证据，并通过共享的瓶颈令牌来融合信息。训练时将同一退化观测的完整视图与子集视图配对，惩罚传感器数量增多却出现更高误差的情况。在几何条件允许时，距离读出仅使用距离测量数据，而预测的其余部分则利用所有可用输入。在五个数据集上进行的配对测试揭示了哪些传感器组合是有益的、哪些是有害的。MakeSense减少了MM-Fi数据集上的负融合现象。借助轻量级适配器和分数据集训练，同一设计还提升了MMAUD上的无人机定位、V2X-Real上的协作式3D检测，以及向RELI11D的少样本姿态迁移等任务的表现。
tldr: 提出多模态融合框架MakeSense，通过私有传感器流保留各自证据并用共享瓶颈令牌融合信息，有效缓解退化感知下“增加传感器反而增大误差”的负融合问题，并在无人机定位、协作3D检测、姿态迁移等多个具身视觉任务上取得提升。
en_tdlr: MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and fuses it via shared bottleneck tokens, mitigates negative fusion under degraded sensing and improves UAV localization, cooperative 3D detection, and pose transfer across multiple embodied vision benchmarks.
